lever: GLM_DIRTY_L2=discard: discard.global.L2 of the consumed split32 MLA partials at the end of the reduce

exactness.construction: released _mla_partial unchanged; reduce = released _mla_reduce body, then a CTA barrier and one predicated discard per consumed 128-byte line; the discarded lines are dead scratch
exactness.gpu_oracle: single GB10, released vs discard at split 32, M3 and M12, eager and CUDA-graph replay, two independent runs: bit-equal (max abs 0.0)
exactness.not_shipped: a device-switchable variant used only for the in-boot timing screen; its split-8 path is not bit-exact against static split 8, and no switchable, RPC or development-mode path is in this repository

microbenchmark.setup: one GB10, serving stopped, 1024-token context, real INT8 o_proj after the MLA and absorbed UV bmm, 20 replays x 2 runs, medians in microseconds
microbenchmark.note: layer-tail figures assume all 78 layers behave like the isolated slice; they are projections, not cycle times

in_boot_ab.config: released short-DSA configuration (native MTP K2 async, split32, RoCE), one boot, discard switched on/off between requests
in_boot_ab.protocol: A1/B/A2 paired rounds, temperature 0, 128 tokens, cycle time from GPU events (max over four ranks), 16 independent groups per width; A/A floor frozen before candidates
in_boot_ab.c4_join: the released layout captures no four-request later-MTP graph (graph sizes 1/3/6/12), so the c4 later MTP step runs eager; c4 scored only cycles shaped exactly target (12,4,3) + first MTP (12,4,3) with the later step eager, identical for both arms
in_boot_ab.verdict: faster at both widths with exact arithmetic; fixed-width cycle time, not a tok/s claim
